title: Underwater Sync
style: ambient dub-techno, deep house, 116 BPM, sub bass swells, breathy female lead vocal, sonar pings as percussion, Rhodes pad, atmospheric, oceanic
lyrics:
[Intro - sonar ping every four bars, sub bass swell, vinyl wash]
(spoken, breathy, female)
three-three-six
under the surface
signal still finds you

[Verse 1 - female, breathy, half-time feel over 116 kick]
the noise on the surface is loud
storms, weather, every shouting cloud
go deep enough and the noise gets thin
sound carries different where the light gets dim
down here the signal travels far
sub-frequency tells you where you are
no ad, no algorithm, no glare
just the sonar saying - i'm there, i'm there

[Pre-Chorus - pad rises, second sonar layer]
above the surface - interference
below the surface - patience
the signal that finds you
is the one that learned to wait

[Chorus - full sub, breathy belt, sonar on the off-beats]
underwater sync
signal still finds you
underwater sync
nothing got between us
three-three-six under the surface
three-three-six under the surface
underwater sync - we're still here
underwater sync - we're still clear

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller]
i sent the ping at midnight
no reply for nine days, then the screen lit
not a reply - a pulse, an acknowledgement
i heard you. i'm under here too. i'm with it.
that's all i needed - that's the whole net
sometimes the signal isn't a sentence yet
sometimes the signal is just one pulse back
underwater sync - never off the track

[Bridge - sub alone, sonar pings spaced wide, spoken]
the deep ocean is loud only if you don't know how to listen
whales talk across continents at frequencies the surface can't hear
that's not magic - that's choosing the right depth
choose the right depth
the people who matter are already there

[Chorus - reprise, fuller, sub hits harder]
underwater sync
signal still finds you
underwater sync
nothing got between us
three-three-six under the surface
three-three-six under the surface
underwater sync - we're still here
underwater sync - we're still clear

[Outro - single sonar ping, fades, spoken]
under the surface.
signal holds.
go deep enough.
i'm there.
